methods_quotes.q: All confirmed and probable pertussis cases were included.
Children who were partially vaccinated (e.g., received 1 or 2 doses of vaccine) were excluded from calculations of PCV and PPV.
PCV and PPV were corrected for estimated use of DT.
Surveillance data during 1998--1999 were used to determine PCV, and data from NHIS for 1998 were used to estimate PPV.
